forbidden: This device cannot archive or restore agents
unsupported: Persona's own conversations are archived from All chats, not from Agents
running: This agent is running or waiting for an answer. Finish or stop it before archiving
storage: Could not save or load agent archives. Please try again
upgrade: Update the assistant to use agent archives
close_busy: This agent is busy (working, waiting for an answer, running a loop, queued messages or a server). Archive it without closing, or wait until it is done
close_offline: Its computer is offline, so the agent is still open there
close_engine: Its engine or another tool keeps this session, so it was left open on the computer
close_not_resumable: It could not be resumed after closing, so it was left open on the computer
close_node_old: Update Persona on that computer to close agents from here
close_refused: The computer would not close this agent, so it is still open
close_failed: Closing the agent on its computer failed, so it may still be open
close_upgrade: Update the assistant to archive and close agents
